config.scope: Existing QNN compression is the primary paper question. One established non-quaternion 4x4 circulant weight-sharing control (Ding2017CirCNN), not a new algebra or a CirCNN/FFT reproduction. Identical scalar widths, trainable real parameter counts, seeded coefficient tensors, input information, BN/ReLU/dropout, 50-epoch training and 3-epoch repair budgets. Circulant groups are not quaternion units. Compare absolute accuracy/CE AND loss from own family baseline, retaining baseline-quality differences. New control selected after inspecting Q/real results; exploratory, not blind independent replication. No claim of isolated quaternion causality, novelty, general superiority, equal MAC/latency, or matched starting quality. No additional Circulant scratch/EuroSAT sweep in this bounded pilot. No official-test inference.
